Calculation Details

How it works

Calculate roof pitch, slope percentage and angle from rise and run. Use the units shown in the calculator and review every assumption before using the result.

Formula

Pitch ratio = rise ÷ run; slope % = ratio × 100; angle = atan(rise ÷ run).

Worked example

A 6-in rise over 12-in run is a 6:12 pitch, 50% slope, about 26.6°.

Important assumptions

This tool is designed for planning and comparison. Real-world prices, manufacturer ratings, building requirements, lender terms, electrical codes, tolerances, and product specifications can vary.

Frequently asked questions
